end.summary:
- Discussed “unity in diversity” and “many in the one.”
- Riya gave examples of different voices, instruments, languages, foods and festivals.
- Riya identified that making everyone the same would remove variety.
- The ideas that diversity divides people and unity requires sameness remained unresolved; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different languages, foods, festivals and music can exist together, and considered why variety makes society richer. They clearly described that forcing everyone to be the same would remove India’s variety. The ideas that diversity causes division and that unity requires everyone to be the same were still mixed up at the last check. At home, ask Riya to give one example of a fair shared rule that lets different festivals or traditions continue.
